items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he was with Gale, wasn't he... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Al Feldman, he's a good arranger.

ctx.x: got something. Sure enough, she never forgotten it. And she did. Chick never got a contract. She never had a contract with Chick, because she said, I made my first amateur contest already. Then she made a big show with Jack Bradshaw, and she went back with Chick because Benny Goodman wanted her. She made a record with Benny Goodman, 'Climbing the Stairway to the Stars', and she went right back with Chick and never signed a contract.

That's a very funny thing, though, when you think -- so she -- Chick gets her, and that's great, isn't it? That's almost the end of his band. From then on that's just really just another -- and I know when I first came here, you know, he was with Gale, wasn't he, and I was just talking to some of them, and I was talking about Edgar Sampson's arrangements. And they say, no, you want to hear what this boy, Al Feldman, can do, you know, the guy that did, 'A Tisket, A Tasket.'
Yeah, Al Feldman, he's a good arranger.
